applicableAreas: All buildings relative to overhead electric lines on property boundaries
findings.comment: Buildings are proposed on site with overhead electric lines on adjacent property boundaries. No surveyed conductor elevations or clearance dimensions are shown on building elevation sheets or plan views to verify the 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance is maintained. Clearance verification exhibits are required.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad location (western side of site, near Building 1)
findings.comment: Transformer pad is shown on the site plan with overhead electric distribution lines on property boundaries, but no clearance dimensions from the outside conductor are provided. The required 15-foot radial clearance from overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors cannot be verified from the available plans.

applicableAreas: All building elevations relative to overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Building elevation sheets do not include surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors. Clearance verification requires registered surveyor data showing conductor elevations and clearance dimensions to building faces and projections. This is a required element per UCM § 1.10.3.

applicableAreas: All site plan sheets and section views
findings.comment: Section and plan view exhibits do not show dimensions from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of buildings, building projections, or other site features. Clearance dimension annotations must originate from the outside conductor (not pole centerline) and extend to building edges and projections.

applicableAreas: All site plan sheets with utility lines or clearances
findings.comment: No clearance dimensions are shown on any plan sheets. Where clearances are required to be dimensioned, the dimension lines must extend from the outside conductor (not from utility pole centerline or pole structure). On multi-conductor installations, the outermost conductor may be several feet offset from pole center.

applicableAreas: Trees planted near overhead electric line on southern property boundary
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows mitigation trees (marked 'M') planted within close proximity to overhead electric line on southern property boundary (approximately 4 trees in southeast corner area). The specific species of these mitigation trees are not identified on the landscape plan, making it impossible to verify whether they are utility-compatible species per ECM Appendix F. Trees within 10 lateral feet of distribution conductors or 50 lateral feet of transmission conductors must be from the Utility Compatible list. Provide plant schedule identifying each mitigation tree species and verify compliance with utility-compatible requirements.

Sheet 3 includes a pre-construction safety meeting requirement (48 hours before construction) for transmission facilities, but does not include a general contractor note requiring notification to Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003. A comprehensive 48-hour notification note applicable to all overhead electric facilities (both distribution and transmission) is required on the cover sheet or general notes.
